contexts.text: This Divine... the Lord took on...
It is this Man (in Heaven) which the Lord took on...
Unless the Lord had taken on the Human...
Whosoever receiveth you, receiveth Me, and he that receiveth Me receiveth Him that sent Me: whosoever receiveth a prophet in the name of a prophet shall receive a prophet's reward... (). AE 624:6.
That Jehovah took on the Human to save men. Explained.
Yet it is from the same (Athanasian Creed) that the Divine took on the Human, that is, united itself to it...
